program.name: freeway-lane-lookup-prediction-v1
program.guidance: Use ONE selected lane, then predict only that car. Step 1: p=observation.player[1]. Select lane by inclusive ranges: 37..52 -> 0; 53..68 -> 1; 69..84 -> 2; 85..100 -> 3; 101..116 -> 4; 117..132 -> 5; 133..148 -> 6; 149..164 -> 7; 165..180 -> 8; 181..196 -> 9. If p is outside 37..196 select UP. Ignore EVERY unselected lane. Step 2: get this lane car bbox=[x,y,8,10] and its xOld from the same lane in the latest history snapshot. dt=current raw_frame minus that snapshot raw_frame. v=((x-xOld+80) modulo 160 minus 80)/dt. Step 3: the chicken moves up about 1 pixel/frame for 16 frames. It starts entering our selected lane at a=p-y-10 and remains relevant through b=min(16,p+8-y). For integer t=a through b, predict q=(x+3+v*t) modulo 160 minus 3. If ANY predicted q satisfies 34<q<52, choose NOOP. If NO predicted q is in that interval, choose UP. DOWN is never prescribed. Examples: p=52 selects lane 0. Its x=46, xOld=50, dt=16: entry t=15 gives q=42.25, so NOOP. p=185 selects lane 9. Its x=8, xOld=5, dt=16 stays far left, so UP regardless of cars in other lanes. p=139 selects lane 6; x=48, xOld=40, dt=16 gives q=51 at entry t=6, so NOOP. The single-lane lookup is mandatory before checking any horizontal position.

action_criteria.NOOP: The ONE selected lane has predicted car x strictly between 34 and 52 at some time during entry. Ignore every other lane.
action_criteria.UP: No selected lane, or its predicted car x never enters (34,52) during entry. Other lanes cannot veto this action.
action_criteria.DOWN: Never selected by the stated policy.

author: interactive-coordinator
rationale: Round 7 single-lane lookup improved reactive own-rule matched agreement from 23/40 to 37/40. Retain that lookup and restore calibrated predictive timing, testing whether better execution can realize the stronger local strategy. This is the sixth and final training proposal.
